phytonTest.name: WebRTC Transport Provider 2.1
phytonTest.comment: Test bug: is_battery_powered() reads PowerSource on endpoint 0 (root node), which doesn't exist on a Matterbridge bridge; PowerSource lives on the bridged endpoint (6).

phytonTest.name: WebRTC Transport Provider 2.2
phytonTest.comment: Gap: deferredOffer is hardcoded true; test expects false (immediate processing) in this scenario. Requires MATTERBRIDGE_STRICT_WEBRTCTRANSPORT=1 on the container to get past its earlier INVALID_COMMAND step (see chipTests.md Known Issues #7).

phytonTest.name: WebRTC Transport Provider 2.3
phytonTest.comment: Fixed (Known Issues #8): passes with MATTERBRIDGE_STRICT_WEBRTCTRANSPORT=1 on the container; fails with the default container, which doesn't set that env var.

phytonTest.name: WebRTC Transport Provider 2.5
phytonTest.comment: Gap: requires MATTERBRIDGE_STRICT_WEBRTCTRANSPORT=1 on the container to get past its earlier steps (Known Issues #8, fixed); then fails because StreamUsage is never validated against StreamUsagePriorities (see chipTests.md Known Issues #10).

phytonTest.name: WebRTC Transport Provider 2.7
phytonTest.comment: Gap: HardPrivacyModeOn never flips when the simulated physical privacy switch is toggled (see chipTests.md Known Issues #2).

phytonTest.name: WebRTC Transport Provider 2.8
phytonTest.comment: Gap: writing SoftRecordingPrivacyModeEnabled returns UnsupportedAttribute, Privacy feature not implemented (see chipTests.md Known Issues #3).

phytonTest.name: WebRTC Transport Provider 2.11
phytonTest.comment: Test bug: same is_battery_powered() endpoint 0 issue as WebRTC Transport Provider 2.1.

phytonTest.name: WebRTC Transport Provider 2.12
phytonTest.comment: Gap: no enforced max concurrent WebRTC sessions; DUT never sends End(OutOfResources) (see chipTests.md Known Issues #4).

phytonTest.name: WebRTC Transport Provider 2.13
phytonTest.comment: Gap: same HardPrivacyModeOn issue as WebRTC Transport Provider 2.7 (see chipTests.md Known Issues #2).

phytonTest.name: WebRTC Transport Provider 2.14
phytonTest.comment: Gap: same SoftRecordingPrivacyModeEnabled issue as WebRTC Transport Provider 2.8 (see chipTests.md Known Issues #3).

phytonTest.name: WebRTC Transport Provider 2.16
phytonTest.comment: Gap: same session-capacity issue as WebRTC Transport Provider 2.12, but the ProvideOffer variant fails with UnsupportedCluster instead of reaching the limit (see chipTests.md Known Issues #4).

phytonTest.name: WebRTC Transport Provider 2.22
phytonTest.comment: Gap: 'TH establishes a valid WebRTC session with DUT' times out during ICE/DTLS completion; not yet root-caused (see chipTests.md Known Issues #5).

phytonTest.name: WebRTC Transport Provider 2.23
phytonTest.comment: Gap: same session-establishment timeout as WebRTC Transport Provider 2.22 (see chipTests.md Known Issues #5).

phytonTest.name: WebRTC Transport Provider 2.24
phytonTest.comment: Gap: unsupported cipher suite is accepted instead of rejected with DynamicConstraintError; no cipher-suite validation implemented (see chipTests.md Known Issues #6).

phytonTest.name: WebRTC Transport Provider 2.25
phytonTest.comment: Gap: same cipher-suite validation gap as WebRTC Transport Provider 2.24 (see chipTests.md Known Issues #6).

phytonTest.name: WebRTC Transport Provider 2.27
phytonTest.comment: Gap: videoStreamID/videoStreams both present isn't rejected with INVALID_COMMAND. Requires MATTERBRIDGE_STRICT_WEBRTCTRANSPORT=1 on the container to get past its earlier INVALID_COMMAND step (see chipTests.md Known Issues #9).

phytonTest.name: WebRTC Transport Provider 2.28
phytonTest.comment: Gap: same deferredOffer issue as WebRTC Transport Provider 2.2. Requires MATTERBRIDGE_STRICT_WEBRTCTRANSPORT=1 on the container to get past its earlier INVALID_COMMAND step (see chipTests.md Known Issues #7).

phytonTest.name: WebRTC Transport Provider 2.29
phytonTest.comment: Fixed (Known Issues #8, ProvideOffer variant): passes with MATTERBRIDGE_STRICT_WEBRTCTRANSPORT=1 on the container; fails with the default container, which doesn't set that env var.

phytonTest.name: WebRTC Transport Provider 2.31
phytonTest.comment: Gap: requires MATTERBRIDGE_STRICT_WEBRTCTRANSPORT=1 on the container to get past its earlier steps (Known Issues #8, fixed); then fails because StreamUsage is never validated against StreamUsagePriorities (see chipTests.md Known Issues #10).
